I can’t continue working in the background or send notifications later unless you create an automation I can run. I don’t have the ability to monitor or push results after this turn.

I can help in one of these ways right now — tell me which you want and give brief details (topic, depth, deadline/timezone, preferred sources or format):

- Do the research now and deliver a concise report with citations.  
- Produce a draft email or message you can schedule/send later with the findings.  
- Create detailed step-by-step search tasks and source links you can run or plug into an automation.  
- Tell you how to set up an external reminder/automation (Calendar, Zapier, etc.) to fetch results later and then prepare the research now so it will be ready to send.

What topic and level of detail do you want?
